name: menubar-animated

frames.best_why: Frame 5 shows the View menu fully open with two checkmarks and a disabled row.

tagline: A desktop-style menu bar whose dropdowns glide between Edit, View and Profiles.
summary: A thin application menu bar with Edit, View and Profiles menus. Opening one shows a dark dropdown of commands with shortcuts and ticks, and moving to a neighbour passes the open menu across in one motion.
appearance: A narrow rounded bar with a thin border holding three small command labels, Edit, View and Profiles, against black. Open, a translucent dark panel hangs below with rows of grey text, right-aligned shortcut hints, a submenu arrow and checkmarks on some rows.
behaviour: Clicking a label drops its menu; moving the pointer along the bar swaps to the next menu with a single gliding highlight and staggered rows. Rows lighten under the cursor, and clicking elsewhere closes the panel.
demo_content: Browser-style commands across Edit, View and Profiles menus, such as New Tab with command-T and Reload.
search_phrases: desktop style menu across the top
dropdown menu that slides between tabs
toolbar of menus on a website
menu that hands off on hover
use_when: A web app imitates a desktop application and needs a compact top menu with several command dropdowns.
avoid_when: Desktop-pointer metaphor: the hover handoff does not translate to touch and the small labels are hard to tap.
customise: Compose menus from the exported parts (triggers, content, items, checkbox and radio items) and style the bar and panels with classes; motion tokens live in the provider.
weight_why: Panels animate through motion and the highlight measures item rectangles while open.

a11y.note: Radix supplies roles, roving focus and Escape, and the provider honours reduced-motion, so the remaining gap is minor.

issues: Disabled rows such as Incognito Window sit very dim on the dark panel, close to unreadable.
The panel is translucent, so its text can lose contrast over busy page content behind it.
polish_why: Detailed motion and crisp panels; disabled rows are dim and the fade still is muddy.
title: Menubar (animated)
